summary: The redeployment plan requires stronger execution-time repository checks, strict configured-branch enforcement, non-blocking or explicitly safe long-running execution, correct conflict handling, configuration-derived command inputs, and expanded backend/frontend tests.
required_fixes: Re-check the Git working tree after confirmation and immediately before execution.
Use only the configured project branch and reject mismatched current branches or arbitrary LLM-provided branches.
Avoid blocking the Supervisor for long Git and Docker operations, preferably through a background deployment job.
Return HTTP 409 for concurrent deployment and guarantee lock release on every failure path.
Reload Supervisor configuration at confirmation time and ignore frontend or stale metadata for paths, services and commands.
Add missing security, timeout, concurrency and frontend confirmation-card tests.
